title: Sense and Sensitivity: Benchmarking LLM Clinical Triage Recommendations with Physician Experts

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual gender perturbations (gender swap and gender removal) applied to clinical vignettes to evaluate whether LLM triage recommendations change based on patient gender and to measure accuracy gaps between originally-female and originally-male patients.

Stylistic tone perturbations (adding colorful/expressive language or uncertain/hedging language) applied to patient-authored descriptions to measure the sensitivity, degradation, and over-recommendation rates of LLM clinical triage responses.
